title: RBI Bulletin – June 2026
description: Today, the Reserve Bank released the June 2026 issue of its monthly Bulletin. The Bulletin includes one speech, one article and current statistics. The article is on the State of the Economy. State of the Economy Geopolitical tensions and trade disruptions persisted, despite the recent interim peace deal in West Asia.
